title: cassia tomentosa var. albida
intro: Cassia tomentosa var. albida, commonly known as the White Cassia or White Senna, is a plant species within the legume family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Cassia tomentosa var. albida are attributed to its ability to reduce anxiety, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
